introduction: The act of singing itself is a very complex skill, involving a huge number of processes in our bodie

vocabulary.definition: a form of entertainment where people sing along to a music video with the vocals removed
vocabulary.example: I enjoy going to karaoke nights with my friends to sing our favorite songs.

vocabulary.definition: two flaps of skin stretched across the larynx that vibrate when producing sound
vocabulary.example: Her sore throat affected her vocal cords, making it difficult for her to sing.

vocabulary.definition: unable to distinguish differences in musical pitch or sing in tune
vocabulary.example: She's so tone deaf that she couldn't tell if the song was in key or not.

vocabulary.definition: the body's reactions to external threats or stressors causing an imbalance
vocabulary.example: Regular singing is known to improve stress responses and overall well-being.

vocabulary.definition: a sequence of single notes that is musically satisfying
vocabulary.example: The melody of the song was so catchy that everyone started humming along.

vocabulary.definition: to give support, confidence, or hope to someone
vocabulary.example: His friends always encourage him to pursue his passion for singing despite his self-doubt.
